findings.label: Nineteen iterations are recorded and three of five key questions are answered at decision level: input-to-model, rule transfer, and sync path; the capability question stops at the documented surface because the CLI was never executed.

The unverified set: no live install, so all verb flags are documentation-grade, and 1.2.0 availability, fj connect labels, fj shape kinds, the node-id return contract, fj info output and rate limits all need a live run.

Nine findings are actionable without a live run: pin 1.2.0, design to the six-verb ceiling, treat Desktop and daemon as prerequisites, split the Project mirror, declare the shared pair, generate the duplicate with a refusal, follow the hub order, separate board from receipt, and treat public exposure as structural.

The precedents converge on six corrections: untracked build output, link refusal and whole-folder replacement from Media Editor; per-packet routers, per-file contract checks and hub gold rows from Moneybird.
The synthesis must supply the later-phase plan itself because plan.md and tasks.md are unfilled template scaffolds and only goal.md carries real acceptance criteria.
A house shape for the synthesis exists in the Moneybird routing research lineage: a fourteen-section research.md with a convergence appendix.
